tasks.description: Add archunit-junit5 1.5.0 and ArchitectureRules (AC-A to AC-F, determinism) built from a root package, with ArchitectureTests on main classes and ArchitectureFixtureTests proving each rule fails on its archfixtures case
Add WebClientScanTests (AC-G patterns, literal stripping, vendor exclusion, 200-line JS budget) with resource fixtures, and SingleModuleScanTests (AC-H) with a @TempDir violation fixture

Add DebtType, HouseholdFlags, Mortgage, Debt, FinancialSnapshot with Invariants (percent normalization per design §2), hasMortgage, totalDebtBalance, and FinancialSnapshotBuilder, with tests for every invariant, scale equality (7.25/7.250/7.2500), over-precision rejection, and debt order

Add StageStatus, StageEvaluation (REQ-004 combinations), Percentages.of/ofRatio, StageEvaluator, StageLadder, LadderResult, and FixedStageEvaluator, with rejecting tests per forbidden combination and ladder tests (all satisfied, skipped below unsatisfied, satisfied above current, missing/duplicate/wrong-stage evaluator)
Add StarterFundEvaluator, DebtFreeEvaluator, FullEmergencyFundEvaluator with boundary tests and verbatim blockers
Add RetirementEvaluator, CollegeEvaluator, MortgageEvaluator, WealthBuildingEvaluator with boundary, skip-precedence, and verbatim copy tests
Add LadderAcceptanceTests for AC-1.1 and AC-1.2 through the real seven-evaluator StageLadder
